Container.Name: dailydrive
Container.Overview: Recreates Spotify Daily Drive by refreshing a playlist with podcasts and music on a schedule. Includes a local web UI for assigning saved Spotify shows to weekday/weekend morning/afternoon slots.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent config, Spotify token, state, podcast slot assignments, and optional .env file.

Config.Name: Show UI Port
Config.Description: Web UI for listing Spotify shows and saving /config/podcast-slots.yaml.

Config.Name: Setup Port
Config.Description: Used only while running the one-time Spotify setup command.

Config.Name: Run On Start
Config.Description: Set to true to refresh once whenever the container starts.

Config.Name: Enable Show UI
Config.Description: Start the show organizer web UI with the scheduler.

Config.Name: Apply Podcast Slots
Config.Description: Before each refresh, update config.yaml podcasts from /config/podcast-slots.yaml using the current weekday/weekend morning/afternoon slot.

Config.Name: Show UI Internal Port
Config.Description: Internal web UI port. Keep this matching the Show UI Port target unless you customize networking.

Config.Name: Recent Show Days
Config.Description: Only list shows with at least one episode released within this many days.

Config.Name: Spotify Market
Config.Description: Market used when checking show episode availability.

Config.Name: Afternoon Start Hour
Config.Description: Hour when afternoon slots begin. Morning is before this hour.

Config.Name: Setup Bind Host
Config.Description: Use 0.0.0.0 so the setup callback is reachable through the mapped port.
